_comment: Reviewed fixes for known Wikidata problems, applied by build_gazetteer.py.
Every entry names a Wikidata item (QID) and a reason, so it can be checked
and ideally fixed upstream on Wikidata too. When Wikidata is fixed, remove
the entry here and rebuild. 'aliases' are other names people still write
in addresses; they are matched but never shown as the official name.

Q132637.reason: Former official name of Mersin province (until 2002).

Q2318164.name: Kahramankazan
Q2318164.reason: Renamed in 2016; Wikidata label is the old name 'Kazan (rayon)'.

Q49103426.name: Eyüpsultan
Q49103426.reason: Renamed in 2017; item has no Turkish label, other labels say 'Eyüp'.

Q2641900.name: Aziziye
Q2641900.reason: Official name is Aziziye; Wikidata label is the old name 'Ilıca'.

Q1012887.name: Ereğli
Q1012887.reason: Official name is 'Ereğli' (Zonguldak); 'Karadeniz Ereğli' is the common name.

Q15961692.name: Ereğli
Q15961692.reason: Duplicate item of Zonguldak/Ereğli with the common name.

Q49103932.name: Güney
Q49103932.reason: Wikidata label 'Güney Bölgesi' (region) is wrong for this district.

Q14329111.name: Selçuklu
Q14329111.reason: Wikidata label 'Selçuklular' is wrong; the district is Selçuklu.

Q2932699.name: Altınordu
Q2932699.reason: Label 'Ordu (Altınordu) ilçesi' would clean to the province name.

Q141623322.reason: Şile district item has no 'located in' (P131) statement.

Q49105637.reason: A Wikimedia disambiguation page wrongly typed as a district of Konya.

Q116788474.reason: Burmageçit is not a district of Tunceli.
